messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — planning to lift the runtime pin for rtime-3.2 in the next maintenance window. Need alignment on SDK compatibility, fallback routes, and release notes. Canary planned: 2026-03-21 16:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: [automated] pinlist update queued: remove rtime-3.2 for group 'prod-edge' at 2026-03-21T16:00Z. CI gating rules will apply.
sam: Do we have an SDK compatibility matrix for 1.9 -> 1.10? I want to know if we need a client shim for streaming APIs.
maria: I'll take release-notes. Draft bullet: "Unpinned runtime rtime-3.2 (canary). Fallback: rtime-3.1 for affected models; recommend SDK 1.10 for best compatibility." Want approval before I open the PR.
taylor: Important: confirm fallback routing includes KV-cache compatibility. If rtime-3.1 has different kvcache layout we might degrade chat performance. Who owns the routing rules?
luisa: QA checklist request: smoke tests for long-seq generation, streaming chunking, embeddings endpoint, and quantized model paths. Need test matrix before canary.
eng-release-oncall: Rollback plan: if we see >3% error rate or >200ms added p95 latency, re-pin via deploy-bot: `deploy-bot pin add rtime-3.2 --reason emergency-rollback` and trigger immediate traffic-shed to backup pool. Keep SLO lookups open.
sam: Quick check command for pinlist (use this in ops runbook):
```
curl -sS "https://deploy.redwood/api/pinlist" | jq '.runtimes["rtime-3.2"]'
```
That shows current pin state and scheduled ops.
taylor: Routing owner is platform-router team — @taylor will ping them and confirm fallback will route to rtime-3.1 with kvcache warmup enabled. Also propose fallback to quant-variant (rtime-3.2-q) only for embeddings.
alex: Also need to update docs: add an API compatibility note in SDK changelog, console note for per-route fallback behavior, and the release notes snippet. Maria — if you open the PR for release-notes, tag docs and devex.
maria: Will do. I can have a PR up within 2 hours after canary start if smoke passes.
luisa: I'll run the smoke matrix at 15:00 UTC and post results. Tests: long-seq (8k tokens), streaming resume, kvcache correctness check (1000 chat exchanges), embeddings parity check.
eng-release-oncall: Canary monitoring hooks: latency p50/p95, error-rate, token-cost delta, and kvcache-miss rate. If kvcache-miss increases >10% -> rollback.
sam: I'll quickly run compatibility checks against gptx-lite-v2, llama2-q, and our internal reranker by 14:00 UTC and paste the matrix.
deploy-bot: [automated] canary scheduled: rtime-3.2 unpin job started at 2026-03-21T16:00Z; monitoring channel: #deploy-canary; notify: eng-sre, eng-runtime.
alex: Thanks — final ask: whoever owns the console docs, please update the per-route note that fallback mapping can change token estimates. Tagging @maria and @taylor. :thumbsup:
maria: ACK — will include a short paragraph and link to ops runbook for rollback steps.
luisa: I'll add test artifacts (logs + perf tables) to the canary thread.
taylor: Pinged platform-router — they confirmed kvcache warmup flag will be set for the canary.
sam: Posting compat matrix now: gptx-lite-v2 -> ok (minor diff in streaming), llama2-q -> embedding offsets changed, we need to note in release notes.
maria: Noted. Adding release note: "Model-specific embedding offsets may vary when falling back; see migration guide."
eng-release-oncall: Reminder: change window ends 18:00 UTC. If no red flags, we proceed to wider rollout at 18:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: [automated] canary results snapshot available: https://ci.redwood/runs/4150001234/snapshot — summary: errors 0.6%, p95 +85ms, kvcache-miss +2%.
alex: Good work. If the snapshot holds, proceed with docs PR merge and rollout plan. I'll keep this thread open until 18:30 UTC.
